# SafePDFHub

> Privacy-first PDF tools that process documents locally in your browser.

SafePDFHub is a browser-based PDF toolkit. Processing is local for tools that support local processing; see each tool page for its workflow and limits.

## PDF tools
- [PDF to Word](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert PDFs to Word documents
- [Compress PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size
- [Merge PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs
- [Split PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/split-pdf): Extract pages from a PDF
- [Protect PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/protect-pdf): Add password protection
- [Unlock PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove password protection
- [Sign PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/sign-pdf): Add a signature and fill fields
- [Watermark PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/watermark-pdf): Add text or image watermark
